acceptance_predicates.description: Supported discover, preflight, quiesce, stage, validate, reopen, and recovery handlers consume current typed Git/SQLite evidence.
The admitted production factory supplies immutable generated operations and live bindings to UpgradeEngine without public bypass.
Injected failure and process death produce durable failed or safe-mode outcomes with no false success.
Unsupported mutation phases remain rejected and public dispatch remains fail-closed.

definition_of_done: Git and SQLite phase wiring and recovery are independently reviewed and hosted-qualified.
Exact post-merge Verify/Formal and state reconciliation pass.

outputs.description: Supported phase orchestration with durable failure classification.

gates.description: Every supported phase rereads durable state and concrete authority identity.
Ambiguous outcomes are durable and non-retryable.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head.
